name: doordash_search_restaurants
intent: Search DoorDash for food and report the first restaurant in the results
description: Searches DoorDash for a requested food or cuisine and returns the name of the first restaurant shown in the search results.
patterns: what is the first DoorDash restaurant for this food

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The food or cuisine to search for in DoorDash.

steps.intent: Type {{search_query}} into the 'Search DoorDash' field and view the results
